title: Growth Manager
description:
About the Starknet Foundation

The Starknet Foundation is the steward of Starknet, a permissionless validity rollup designed to scale the world’s most important blockchains without compromise. Having pioneered ZK-STARK technology to scale Ethereum, we are now entering a new era as the first network to settle simultaneously on both Bitcoin and Ethereum.

Joining the Starknet Foundation now places you at the epicenter of this pivotal phase and offers a rare, ground-floor opportunity to shape how Starknet's core growth verticals evolve: from BTCFi and privacy to quantum resistance and real-world assets. This is a unique chance to build the infrastructure that turns the world's most secure assets and most sensitive use cases into productive, scalable capital for a billion users, and it requires exceptional talent. We're looking for people who think in systems, operate well in ambiguity, and are motivated by long-term impact over short-term wins. If you want your work to outlast a market cycle and define how decentralized systems actually scale, this is the place to do it.

 

What You’ll Bring

  • Senior generalist with a proven ability to operate cross-functionally across strategy, BD, partnerships, and product development.

  • Crypto and DeFi native with minimum 5+ years of experience.

  • Ideal background in banking, management consulting or legal training, with experience at a Tier one company within the industry.

  • Strong commercial and research skills, including the ability to build clear business cases and financial models.

  • A deep crypto network and a track record of building senior relationships with DeFi protocols, LPs and financial institutions that generated revenue/growth.

What You Need To Succeed

  • Self-starter with high energy, motivation, and ambition.

  • Comfortable defining success for a specific vertical, identifying gaps and reallocating efforts toward the highest-value opportunities.

  • Proven ability to influence senior executives and work effectively with stakeholders across the organisation.

  • Strong deal experience and negotiation skills

What You’ll Do

  • Take ownership of strategy and execution across the Growth team's priority verticals (Privacy, Bitcoin, Quantum, RWA), with the flexibility to shift focus as new opportunities and priorities emerge.

  • Identify, negotiate and manage partnerships end-to-end to extend and strengthen Starknet’s infrastructure stack.

  • Develop commercial proposals that drive growth across the Starknet ecosystem.

  • Work with product, ecosystem and marketing teams to identify and build new solutions that drive partner ecosystem success.

  • Partner with legal, finance, and operations teams to support existing and upcoming partnerships.

  • Represent Starknet at conferences and industry events to enhance visibility and connection to top-tier projects.

Location:

We are a globally dispersed, remote-first organization. However, for this role we are partial to candidates based and with networks in: APAC (Singapore/HK) and NYC.

title: Social Media Marketer
description:
About the Role:

We’re hiring a Social Media Marketer to help Starknet show up consistently, clearly, and credibly across our core social channels - @starknet and @starknetfndn. This role sits within the GTM team and reports directly to our Marketing Lead. The focus is social: developing a strong point of view, finding the right moments to enter conversations, turning Starknet’s technology and ecosystem into compelling content, and building the kind of consistent presence that strengthens brand recognition over time.

What You'll Do:

  • Own and run Starknet's and Starknet Foundation's social channels (X, blog, LinkedIn, Telegram), keeping posting and engagement consistently high quality.

  • Turn marketing strategy, ecosystem narratives, and campaign direction into clear, on-brand content (both long and short form) for crypto-native, technical, and consumer audiences alike.

  • Manage the social content calendar and incoming requests across the organization. This requires real organizational skill and comfort with project-management tools, not just content instincts.

  • Be the go-to point for ecosystem social activity: field requests from partners and decide how and when to spotlight launches, events, and key moments.

  • Build and run channel-specific posting strategies that balance planned content with real-time, reactive engagement.

  • Track conversations, trends, and sentiment across the ecosystem and broader crypto space, and use performance data to continuously sharpen content and strategy.

  • Engage directly with the community: responding, contextualizing, and escalating thoughtfully and credibly.

  • Partner closely with GTM, Growth, Product, and other teams to keep social execution aligned with broader Foundation priorities.

  • Help shape and evolve Starknet's brand voice on social alongside the greater Marketing team.

What You Bring:

  • Deep understanding of Starknet's place in the market: its strengths, trade-offs, and how to talk about them credibly with audiences beyond retail crypto users.

  • Strong, well-informed opinions about what performs on Crypto Twitter and what actually serves the brand - with the judgment to tell the two apart.

  • 3+ years of hands-on social media marketing experience, ideally in crypto/web3.

  • Solid working knowledge of blockchain and DeFi fundamentals (AMMs, staking, governance, lending, the L2 landscape) - enough to engage technical audiences with confidence.

  • A strong, versatile writer who can translate complex ideas into content that lands across a range of audiences.

  • Experience operating social channels in fast-moving environments, including reactive posting and real-time engagement.

  • Comfortable with social analytics and monitoring tools, using data to guide content and channel decisions.

  • A highly reliable, organized operator who can manage multiple threads without losing sight of the details.

  • Confident owning execution independently, while staying collaborative and coordinated with the wider team.

  • Comfortable being a visible presence for the brand - hosting Spaces, replying from the account, and engaging actively on CT.

This role is remote and engaged through our UK entity, Tzolkin Limited.

title: Quant Trader
description:
About Kappa Lab:

Kappa Lab is a digital-assets market maker. We provide continuous, round-the-clock liquidity across 50+ centralised and decentralised exchanges, quoting a wide range of assets. Our proprietary technology and quantitative models let us price consistently and respond quickly across every venue we trade.

About the role:

As a Quantitative Trader you will join a hands-on trading team, taking ownership of live market-making strategies while researching and prototyping new ones. This is a role for someone who enjoys the challenge of achieving high performance and PnL plus the analytical side of markets and the engineering that makes trading work in practice.

What you will do:

  • Own live market-making strategies: tune quoting parameters, spreads, sizing and hedging, and diagnose and improve performance
  • Research, prototype and launch new quantitative strategies across venues and asset classes
  • Analyse execution quality in depth - fill quality, adverse selection, realised spreads, and trading costs
  • Work in our configuration-as-code platform, where strategy parameters are version-controlled, reviewed and deployed like software
  • Monitor live trading and manage risk through volatile market conditions
  • Work closely with engineering on the systems you trade through, and contribute code to them yourself

What we are looking for:

  • Strong quantitative reasoning and real comfort applying statistics to noisy, fast-moving data
  • Production-grade Python: code others can maintain, sensible use of version control, and the ability to debug a live system under pressure
  • Evidence you can turn large market datasets into a decision and clearly explain your reasoning
  • Familiarity with cryptocurrency markets, blockchain technology, and trading concepts
  • Sound judgement about risk: knowing when to size down, hedge or stop
  • A proactive mindset and ability to spot opportunities, move fast, and make things happen

Strongly valued:

  • Experience in market making, high-frequency trading, or systematic execution
  • Proficiency in Rust
  • Familiarity with DeFi and on-chain execution

Location and Working Style:

We have offices in London (UK) and Dubai (UAE) and operate on a hybrid basis.

title: Product Owner Tangem Pay
description:
📈

Product Owner (Tangem Pay)

Tangem is building the world’s most advanced self-custodial financial platform, redefining how people store, grow, and spend digital value at global scale.

Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Zug, Switzerland, Tangem operates globally across North America, Europe, and APAC. The company pioneered hardware-based self-custody by combining secure smartcard technology with a seamless mobile experience, enabling millions of users to hold and use digital assets with instant setup, zero complexity, and institutional-grade security.

Today, Tangem serves customers in over 220 countries, supporting thousands of digital assets through a single, ultra-secure hardware wallet. Setup takes less than one minute, with no seed phrases, no friction, and no compromise on security. This foundation positions Tangem as one of the few companies capable of bringing self-custody to true mass adoption.

Tangem Pay extends this foundation into real-world finance. It transforms the Tangem Wallet into a full self-custodial payment account, allowing users to seamlessly move from storing value to spending it anywhere cards are accepted globally. The product is live, production-ready, and built to scale across regions, currencies, and regulatory environments.

With Tangem Pay, we are not launching “another crypto card.” We are building the spending layer of a new financial system where self-custody, payments, and global usability converge. The infrastructure is live, the partners are in place, and the roadmap is designed for rapid global expansion.

About the Role

The Product Owner will be responsible for all Tangem Pay (TP) related products, including payment flows, internal tooling, financial rails, and monitoring capabilities.

The role focuses on product execution, reliability, and operational scalability, rather than commercial ownership.

We see a potential opportunity for Tangem in the professional wealth and institutional segment, including family offices, HNWs, wealth managers, RIAs, corporate treasuries, and other financial institutions.

Our goal is not to become a regulated custodian, but to explore whether Tangem can serve as a secure self-custody and access-control solution, independently or alongside existing custody infrastructure.

The Role

We are looking for a senior US financial-services professional to lead a focused market research and strategy project.

We do not want to start with a predefined product or business model. The first objective is to understand how professional clients currently manage digital assets, what problems they face, where existing solutions fall short, and whether there is a meaningful commercial opportunity for Tangem.

Based on this research, the person will define who we should target, what we should build, how we should go to market, and how Tangem can monetize the opportunity.

1. Market Research & Customer Discovery

  • Interview family offices, HNWs, RIAs, wealth managers, corporate treasuries, custodians, and other relevant players
  • Understand current digital-asset custody, security, governance, recovery, and reporting processes
  • Map existing solutions and competitors

  • Prioritize the most attractive customer segments, use cases, potential partners, and pilot customers

2. Product & Business Strategy

Based on the findings:

  • Define priority customer segments and use cases
  • Develop Tangem's value proposition and positioning
  • Identify required product capabilities and integrations
  • Recommend an MVP / pilot
  • Define regulatory and operational considerations
  • Build an initial go-to-market strategy

Potential requirements could include multi-user approvals, permissions, transaction controls, audit trails, recovery, reporting, and integrations — but these should be validated through research rather than assumed upfront.

3. Monetization & P&L

  • Identify and validate potential revenue models
  • Define pricing and packaging
  • Assess customer willingness to pay
  • Estimate market and revenue potential
  • Define required product, sales, operational, and support investments
  • Build an initial P&L, including revenue, margins, costs, and break-even scenarios
  • Define commercial KPIs and investment required to launch and scale

Key Deliverables

The project should result in:

  1. Market and customer research with prioritized segments and use cases
  2. Recommended product / MVP and value proposition
  3. Go-to-market and partnership strategy
  4. Monetization and pricing model
  5. Potential pilot customer and partner pipeline
  6. Financial model and P&L
  7. Final go / no-go recommendation and launch roadmap

Ideal Background

We are looking for someone with senior experience in private wealth, family offices, RIAs, institutional digital assets, custody, corporate treasury, private banking, or WealthTech / FinTech.

The ideal candidate should have a strong US industry network, experience in customer discovery and new business development, and the ability to translate market insights into product strategy, commercial model, and P&L.

We are building capability for Tangem customers to trade US equities inside the mobile app (iOS/Android), with an external tech vendor as our partner. The US entity, its licensed officers, and the local regulatory work sit with outsourced specialists and external advisors. Everything those people need in order to do their jobs comes from headquarters — and that is your job. You are not the compliance function and you are not expected to be a securities expert. You are the person at HQ who makes sure the advisors, external tech vendor, and the internal teams have the information they need, and that requests are tracked, followed up and escalated where necessary.

Responsibilities:

  • Assemble and maintain the HQ-side inputs our external advisors need for the broker-dealer application: business and product descriptions, funding and money-flow narratives, technology and vendor schedules, organisational and reporting structure, and whatever else they ask for. You chase the underlying facts inside Tangem AG and turn them into what the advisors actually need.
  • Run the document request list: advisors and counsel will send us long lists with dates on them. You own the tracker, the owners, and the follow-ups, and you flag slippage before it becomes a delay.
  • Support the clearing broker relationship: consolidate our open questions, track their answers, keep a current view of what has been agreed and what is still open across clearing, API coverage, market data, KYC allocation, and commercial terms.
  • Hold external advisors to account as suppliers: read their drafts, catch places where they have misdescribed our product or our funding flow, and get corrections made rather than accepting the first version.
  • Produce revenue and cost estimates for the equities business, and keep them current as the commercial terms with the clearing broker and our vendors firm up.
  • Run competitor and market research on US retail brokerage and crypto-adjacent equities offerings; turn it into short memos that lead with a conclusion.
  • Keep documentation current — process maps, flow diagrams, and internal briefing material that design, engineering, and the US entity team can all work from.
  • Brief marketing and content so external communication describes the product accurately. In a regulated business the cost of a loose claim is higher than usual.

Requirements:

  • 3+ years as a business analyst, project or programme coordinator, consultant, or in an operations role.
  • Background in trading, brokerage, asset management, or financial services more broadly. We would strongly prefer someone who already understands how a brokerage business makes money and where its operational risks sit, rather than someone learning that on the job while coordinating a licence application.
  • Evidence of having assembled material for a regulatory filing, licence application, audit, or major vendor due-diligence process. Any jurisdiction — this is the closest analogue to the work.
  • Comfortable managing external advisors and law firms as suppliers: scoping them, holding dates, and pushing back on a draft that is wrong.
  • Organised under pressure across many parallel threads, with a working style that closes loops without being chased. Much of this role is knowing what is outstanding, from whom, and by when.
  • Precise written English. Specs, memos, and trackers that are short, structured, and unambiguous.
  • Effective across time zones and across a headquarters/subsidiary split, where the people who need information and the people who hold it are rarely in the same room.

Nice to have:

  • Able to read a technical document or an API description well enough to describe a system accurately in writing, and to talk to developers without needing a translator.
  • Securities regulation or fintech licensing exposure; experience supporting a market-entry or new-entity project; SQL or Python for quick data pulls; Figma and MIRO; crypto literacy and self-custody familiarity (relevant later, when tokenised equities enter scope).

What We Offer:

  • Stability, development, participation in the future unicorn's growth.
  • Remote work from anywhere in the world, excluding Russia and Belarus, with a schedule aligned with GMT+3.
  • Competitive salary in EUR/USDT.

certifications such as SailPoint, Saviynt, Okta, CyberArk, AWS or equivalent.

including authentication, authorization, identity lifecycle, federation, and
access governance.
* Experience designing and delivering IAM solutions across cloud, SaaS, and
enterprise environments.
* Good understanding of IAM standards and technologies such as SSO, MFA,
SAML, OAuth/OIDC, SCIM, RBAC, and directory services.
* Experience with identity lifecycle management, access governance,
privileged access, and periodic access reviews.

use cases is desirable.
* Familiarity with leading IAM, IGA, or PAM platforms and experience
participating in technology evaluation, PoCs, or implementations.
* Ability to translate business and security requirements into practical,
scalable IAM solutions.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to
work effectively with both technical and business teams.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to manage
multiple priorities and drive initiatives in a fast-paced environment.

cross-functional partners like Product, Engineering, Security, and Marketing

* IAM Strategy & Architecture: Align and operate enterprise IAM strategy,
target architecture, and operating model inline with  business, security, and
cloud-first objectives.
* Identity Governance & Lifecycle: Run operational processes to maintain
end-to-end identity lifecycle processes covering Joiner-Mover-Leaver (JML),
access requests and approvals, provisioning/deprovisioning, RBAC, role
management, and periodic access reviews.
* Authentication & Access Management: Ensure alignment of operations with
SSO, MFA, Conditional Access, federation, and secure access patterns across
SaaS applications, cloud platforms, and enterprise systems.
* Non-Human & Machine Identities: Govern service accounts, workload
identities, API credentials, automation identities, machine-to-machine access,
and emerging AI/agentic identities.
* Privileged Access Management: Secure operations and monitoring covering
privileged identities, JIT/JEA access, credential management, session controls,
privileged access monitoring, and integration with enterprise PAM solutions.
* Cloud & Endpoint Identity: Design identity solutions across the
organization's cloud and end user environment.
* Technology Evaluation & Implementation: Lead IAM requirements, RFI/RFP,
vendor evaluations, PoCs, technology selection, and implementation planning,
while assessing the evolution of the current JumpCloud-based environment.
* IAM Standards & Governance: Establish IAM policies, standards, reference
architectures, integration patterns, operational processes, and
identity/application ownership models.
* Stakeholder & Compliance Management: Partner with Security, Infrastructure,
Cloud, DevOps, HR, Engineering, Compliance, and Application teams to drive
secure IAM operations.

Drive intercompany reconciliations, eliminations, consolidation adjustments
and standardisation of accounting and reporting practices.

Oversee critical reconciliations across intercompany balances, VDA/crypto
assets, INR/fiat balances, banks, customer assets and liabilities, exchanges
and other key accounts.

Ensure timely identification, investigation and resolution of reconciliation
breaks, aged items and reporting differences.

Drive automation and process improvements to enable faster closes and
stronger financial insights.

payment governance.

Strengthen accounts payable, vendor payments, ageing and payment controls.

Improve cash visibility, forecasting, automation and efficiency across
treasury and payment processes.

Build strong ownership, review mechanisms and controls across treasury and AP
operations.

processes.

Identify control gaps, operational risks and process inefficiencies and drive

Drive automation and standardisation across finance systems, reconciliations

Partner with Technology, Data and business teams on ERP optimisation and
finance transformation initiatives.

Support internal and external audits and ensure timely closure of audit
observations.

diligence and new business initiatives.

Partner with senior leadership on complex financial, accounting and business
matters.

Help build finance processes, reporting and governance capabilities aligned

Exposure to IPO readiness, financial reporting and governance will be an

Experience in finance transformation, process improvement or ERP

Interest in leveraging automation, analytics and AI to improve finance

Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.

Search is being rewritten in real time. Google is no longer the only front
door – Indians increasingly discover crypto through AI answer engines,
generative search, and app store surfaces before they ever reach a website.
You'll own how millions of them find, trust, and choose CoinDCX across every
one of these surfaces: organic web, the Play Store and App Store, and the
fast-emerging world of AI-driven search (AEO, GEO, and LLM answers).

and most defensible growth levers – and because the rules of that channel are
changing faster than they ever have. You'll set the strategy, build the
systems, and own the programmatic infrastructure that keep us visible and
authoritative as search fragments across traditional engines, app stores, and
large language models.


What You'll Do


* Own end-to-end SEO strategy across technical, on-page, off-page, and
programmatic – driving qualified organic traffic, rankings, and conversions at
scale.
* Lead App Store Optimization (ASO) across the Play Store and App Store –
metadata, creatives, keyword rankings, ratings, and A/B experiments that grow
installs and install-to-activation.

(featured snippets, People Also Ask, voice), GEO (Perplexity, ChatGPT Search,
Gemini, AI Overviews), and LLM citations so we are the source AI models quote
on crypto.

scale content and structured data across thousands of high-intent pages.
* Partner cross-functionally with Product, Tech, Design, and Analytics to
ship SEO-first site architecture, schema, Core Web Vitals, and clean analytics
instrumentation.

tracking across organic, app store, and AI-surface visibility.

the entire discovery channel.

driving organic growth at scale.

retrieve, rank, and cite content.

Core Web Vitals, and log-file analysis.

senior stakeholders.

ambiguous, fast-shifting landscape.

You'll Know You're Winning When


* Organic and app-store channels are compounding month over month in
qualified traffic, installs, and activation.

* Documentation & Reporting: Maintain immaculate records of all actions

especially when dealing with legal documentation and sensitive customer data.

About the Role:

This isn’t a typical Market Risk role.

This role is suited for a hands-on risk professional who can independently
execute BAU monitoring, build practical dashboards and controls, analyse market
events, and escalate issues with clarity across spot, derivatives, and
custody-linked exposures. You will work closely with the Manager and
cross-functional teams to strengthen risk measurement, liquidation and margin
monitoring, liquidity and slippage views, governance processes, and day-to-day
risk actions.


What You’ll Do:

1) Risk Measurement & Monitoring (BAU)

Build, maintain, and run core risk views such as VaR (1-day/10-day), stress
tests, scenario loss, and drawdown / regime indicators for key exposures
including spot, perps / futures, and funding or basis-linked positions.

Monitor volatility, correlations, concentration, and tail-risk indicators on
a daily basis; identify changes in risk posture and escalate material
observations in a timely manner.

Prepare daily and periodic risk summaries with clear commentary, exceptions,
and recommended follow-ups.

2) Limits, Appetite & Governance Support

Support the implementation and ongoing monitoring of risk limits across
notional, leverage, concentration, liquidity / slippage, and basis or funding
exposures.

Track breaches, exceptions, and threshold movements; maintain escalation
logs, decision records, and supporting governance documentation.

Assist in drafting and maintaining runbooks, SOPs, and risk dashboards so
that BAU processes remain consistent, auditable, and scalable.

3) Derivatives & Liquidation Risk Controls

Monitor margin and liquidation risk across derivatives books, including mark
vs LTP behaviour, index / mark quality, liquidation outcomes, and tail-day
stress performance.

Build and track metrics such as distance-to-liquidation (DTL), effective
leverage, margin utilisation, and early-warning indicators at user, token, or
portfolio level where relevant.

Partner with Product, Operations, and Engineering teams to improve practical
guardrails such as risk checks, throttles, alerting logic, and reduce-only or
similar protective actions.

4) Liquidity & Slippage Risk

Build and maintain liquidity risk views covering order book depth, spreads,
market impact, slippage, and exit capacity under normal and stressed conditions.

Support stress liquidation cost analysis and time-to-exit estimation across
key tokens, books, and liquidity regimes.

Highlight thin-liquidity, concentration, and execution-risk hotspots that
may require tighter controls or closer monitoring.

5) Risk Support & Cross-Functional Analysis

Support analysis of venue constraints, hedgeability, pricing frictions, and
operational limitations that can affect market risk outcomes.

Contribute to exposure monitoring across related areas such as stablecoin /
INR conversion impacts, treasury-linked positions, or exchange-specific market
structure issues where relevant.

Work with stakeholders across Risk, Treasury, Product, Trade Ops, and
Analytics to improve data quality, monitoring coverage, and response readiness.

6) Controls, Incidents & Post-Mortems

Participate in incident reviews for market events, liquidation anomalies,
pricing deviations, or control breakdowns; produce clear root-cause and impact
analysis.

Maintain thresholds, control inventories, SOPs, and tracker-based follow-ups
so that risk actions are implemented and closed out properly.

Recommend practical process improvements that help move quick tactical
monitoring into stronger BAU governance over time.


You’ll Excel in This Role If You:

1–2 years of experience in market risk, trading risk, treasury risk,
derivatives risk, or similar roles in a crypto exchange, broker, prop
environment, market maker, or related trading business.

Good understanding of derivatives mechanics, including margining,
liquidation flows, funding rates, basis behaviour, and risk transmission during
stressed markets.

Strong market microstructure intuition, including order book behaviour,
spreads, impact, mark vs LTP dynamics, manipulation or wick risk, and
thin-liquidity conditions.

Hands-on comfort with risk analytics such as historical VaR, stress /
scenario testing, drawdowns, and regime-based monitoring.

Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills; working knowledge of SQL preferred;
familiarity with dashboarding, data handling, or light automation is desirable.

Ability to communicate risk observations clearly, maintain structured
documentation, and work effectively in a fast-moving operating environment.


You’ll Know You’re Winning When:


* Your risk frameworks directly guide trading and product decisions, keeping
the platform within strong risk boundaries.
* You establish a trusted, real-time “source of truth” for risk across spot
and derivatives.
* You anticipate market risks early and convert them into clear actions,
thresholds, and playbooks.

manage market volatility.

implementing and independently overseeing the regulatory compliance framework
for the Company’s Broker-Dealer and Introducing Broker operations in GIFT IFSC.
The CO will monitor adherence to applicable IFSCA regulations, circulars,
directions and other regulatory requirements and provide independent compliance
advice, monitoring and challenge to the business.

You need to be a HODLer of these


* A professional qualification or postgraduate degree/postgraduate diploma of
at least one year in Finance, Law, Accountancy, Business Management, Commerce,
Economics, Capital Markets, Banking, Insurance, Actuarial Science, FinTech,
Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics; or CFA / FRM; or such other
relevant qualification as may be specified by IFSCA. Provided that minimum two
years of experience in the financial services market. Experience in another
field may be considered with at least two years of work experience in a
compliance-related role or function.

of work experience in the financial services market, in accordance with
applicable IFSCA requirements.

regulation, regulatory compliance, AML/CFT or financial-services compliance is
preferred.

regulatory reporting, client protection and compliance-monitoring frameworks.
* Strong regulatory interpretation, analytical, monitoring and documentation
skills.
* Ability to exercise independent judgement, challenge and escalation on
regulatory and compliance matters.

regulators, exchanges, auditors and senior management.
* High standards of integrity, independence and regulatory judgement.
* Must be based out of the IFSC, as required under applicable IFSCA
regulations.
* Must complete certification course "Regulatory Framework for Capital Market
Intermediaries in IFSC (ICSI)" as prescribed by IFSCA.


You will be mining through these tasks


* Establish, implement and maintain an effective regulatory compliance
framework for the Broker-Dealer and Introducing Broker activities and monitor
ongoing compliance with the IFSCA (Capital Market Intermediaries) Regulations,
applicable Broker-Dealer requirements, exchange requirements and circulars and
directions.

applicable.

timely completion of regulatory filings, returns, disclosures, certifications

onboarding, KYC/CDD, AML/CFT, sanctions screening, transaction monitoring and

operational teams.

prudential requirements, in coordination with Finance and Compliance.

regulatory breaches or material compliance risks, and track corrective actions

arrangements prior to implementation.

Build ecosystem relationships

ecosystem.

or hands-on exposure to the crypto or fintech ecosystem.

opportunities mapped to clear theses.

title: Talent Operations Executive
description:

Role Summary


We are looking for a detail-oriented and highly organized Talent Operations &
Pre-Onboarding Specialist to manage end-to-end recruitment operations,
candidate pre-onboarding, and interview coordination.

This role is critical in ensuring a seamless candidate experience from
application to Day 1, while maintaining strong governance, data accuracy, and
stakeholder communication.


Key Responsibilities


1) Application & Candidate Screening Operations


* Own and manage the Apply Mailbox, ensuring 100% review of all incoming
applications.
* Conduct initial due diligence to assess candidate relevance.
* Share suitable profiles with recruiters or move them into the talent pool
with proper tagging and documentation.
* Ensure no candidate application is missed or left unattended.


2) Interview Coordination & Tracking


* Coordinate and schedule all interviews across roles and panels.
* Ensure daily tracking of all interviews scheduled.
* Best practice:
* Review the interview schedule every morning.
* Send gentle reminders to candidates and panelists with time, role name, and
interview details.
* If an interview does not take place, proactively reschedule based on
candidate and panelist availability.
* Share a daily interview summary sheet (next day) capturing:
* Candidate name
* Role
* Interview stage
* Panelist feedback
* Current status
* Follow up with panelists if feedback is not shared within defined timelines.


3) Pre-Onboarding & Joining Confidence Management (JCS)

* Own the entire pre-onboarding process for all offered candidates.
* Track candidates marked as "Offered" on TA-MIS and ensure accurate data
transfer to:
* Post offer connects Sheet
* Connects Date sub-sheet
* Conduct Joining Confidence Scoring using pre-scripted questions.
* Flag candidates immediately if:
* Joining Confidence Score drops below 100
* Escalate to Recruiter & relevant stakeholder
* Maintain real-time status and accuracy across all tracking sheets.


4) Stakeholder Connects & Candidate Engagement

* Coordinate connects with:
* Hiring Manager (HM)
* Head of Department (HOD)
* HRBP
* Schedule calls and, where required, coordinate office visits / office tours.
* Ensure high-touch engagement to reduce drop-offs and increase joining
confidence.


5) Documentation & Compliance Tracking

* Track and ensure timely submission of all required documents, including:
* Banking details
* PIF
* Other onboarding documentation
* Follow up proactively with candidates for missing or incorrect documents.


6) Asset & Joining Day Readiness

* Raise asset requests via Slack form at least one week prior to the
candidate's joining date.
* One day before joining:
* Connect with candidates to confirm:
* Office address
* Reporting time (9:30 AM on orientation day)
* Support joining-day readiness through:
* Candidate communication
* Coordination with internal teams
* (Future scope) Support joining-day initiatives such as welcome lunch with
team buddy.


You'll Excel If You Have

* 1–4 years of experience in:
* Talent Acquisition Operations
* Recruitment Coordination
* HR Operations or Pre-Onboarding
* Prior experience managing interview logistics and onboarding processes is
preferred.
* Strong attention to detail and follow-through.
* High ownership mindset and accountability.
* Excellent coordination and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple trackers, sheets, and processes without errors.
* Clear written and verbal communication.
* Strong candidate experience orientation.
* Comfortable working with TA-MIS, Google Sheets / Excel, Slack, and calendars
.


Preferred Qualifications

* Experience managing high-volume interview coordination.
* Experience handling candidate pre-onboarding and documentation processes.
* Familiarity with recruitment operations and candidate lifecycle management.
* Exposure to stakeholder coordination across recruiters, hiring managers,
and HR teams.


Technical Skills

* Tools: TA-MIS, Google Sheets / Microsoft Excel, Slack, Google Calendar
* Operations: Interview scheduling, recruitment coordination, pre-onboarding,
documentation tracking
* Coordination: Stakeholder management, candidate engagement, process tracking


What We're Looking For

* Attention to Detail: Strong accuracy across trackers, documentation, and
recruitment operations.
* Ownership: Ability to independently manage multiple processes end-to-end.
* Coordination Skills: Excellent stakeholder management across recruiters,
candidates, hiring managers, and HR teams.
* Communication: Clear written and verbal communication with internal and
external stakeholders.
* Candidate Experience: Passion for creating a seamless candidate journey
from application through joining.
* Organisation: Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining
operational excellence.


You'll Know You're Winning When

* Zero missed applications or interviews.
* High joining confidence and reduced offer drop-offs.
* Accurate, real-time tracking across all sheets and systems.
* Smooth candidate experience from offer to Day 1.
* Strong trust and reliability with recruiters and business stakeholders.


Hiring Process


Here's what your journey with us looks like:

role alignment.
* Recruiter Connect – A conversation to understand your background,
coordination experience, and career aspirations.
* Functional Round(s) – A deep dive into recruitment operations, interview
coordination, stakeholder management, and problem-solving approach.

collaborate, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
* Founder Conversation (Optional) – For select roles, you may meet our
founders to explore long-term alignment.


Where We Work

speed, and trust come alive when teams share the same space.

based out of ourBangalore office, where energy, alignment, and innovation move

This isn’t a typical quant research role.

You will spearhead our research into crypto market making across Spot and
Futures markets — designing the pricing, hedging, and risk models that
determine how competitively and profitably we provide liquidity. In the
hyper-volatile, 24/7 crypto landscape, static models decay fast, so your
mandate is to build market making strategies that are adaptive, robust, and
continuously improving.

This is a deep research role focused on long-term, structural improvements to
our MM engine that the BAU team then deploys and manages. You’ll own the
hardest questions on the desk: how to price and hedge across Spot and Futures,
how to read order book dynamics and market regimes, and how to keep strategies
healthy in live markets — using AI and automation where they give us a real
edge.


What You’ll Do

1. Design advanced market making algorithms


* Adaptive Pricing & Hedging: Design pricing and hedging algorithms for Spot
and Futures markets, specifically managing basis and funding-rate risk across
the two.
* Liquidation Logic: Research and optimise intelligent liquidation models to
minimise market impact and slippage in high-leverage Futures environments.
* Quoting & Inventory: Develop models for optimal quoting, spread setting,
and inventory management that hold up across varied market conditions.2.
Research crypto microstructure & signals


* Order Book Intelligence: Analyse limit order book (LOB) dynamics to
identify “toxic flow” from sophisticated actors, and aggregate liquidity across
fragmented CEX/DEX venues.
* Regime Detection: Build models to detect shifts in market volatility and
liquidity so our bots can widen or tighten spreads as regimes change.3. Build
predictive risk & strategy monitoring


* Risk Prediction: Build predictive models for inventory risk management,
ensuring optimal position sizing across volatile crypto assets.
* Strategy Health: Design monitoring that detects strategy decay or anomalous
P&L behaviour on live bots before it becomes critical — leveraging automated,
always-on “watchdog” agents for 24/7 coverage.4. Deep-dive R&D & tech liaison


* Emerging Venues: Conduct long-term research on liquidity provision in
emerging crypto sub-sectors (e.g. L2s, Perpetual DEXs).
* Technical Blueprints: Author BRDs (Business Requirement Documents) to guide
the Quant dev team in implementing your strategy and agent architectures.5.
Backtesting & AI-driven research pipelines


* Robust Backtesting: Develop rigorous backtesting environments — including
adversarial stress scenarios such as flash crashes and exchange outages — to
validate MM strategies before deployment.
* Research Automation: Use AI-driven pipelines to automate feature
engineering and scale backtesting across thousands of crypto pairs,
accelerating the research loop.


You’ll Excel in This Role If You


* Market Making Research: Have built mathematical models and backtesting
frameworks specifically for market-making or high-frequency environments.
* Crypto Native Mindset: Have a deep understanding of crypto-specific
nuances: funding rates, perpetual swaps, basis, CEX vs. DEX liquidity, and
on-chain data.
* Data Tooling: Are an expert in Python, with experience handling tick-level
data and high-throughput data pipelines.
* Risk Appreciation: Focus on “Anti-Fragility” — building systems that thrive
in the chaos of crypto markets through robust risk controls.
* AI/ML (a strong plus): Have interest or experience applying modern AI/ML —
Reinforcement Learning, LLMs, or agentic frameworks — to financial time-series
and research automation.

Design scalable research programmes that continuously monitor customer,
product, and brand health.

This isn’t a typical quant developer role.

You will own the systems that quote prices and manage risk across crypto
markets in real time — the engine that lets CoinDCX provide deep, reliable
liquidity to every trader on our platform. This is work that directly shapes
how price discovery and market quality happen for millions of Indian users.

We’re looking for a builder who can architect low-latency market making
infrastructure in C++, connect resiliently to multiple exchanges over WebSocket
and REST, and lead a small team of quant developers. You’ll be hands-on with
the hardest engineering on the desk: keeping order books accurate under messy,
high-rate, sometimes-failing exchange feeds, and turning microsecond-level
decisions into consistent PnL. You will set the technical bar for how we build,
measure, and scale our trading systems.

What You’ll Do


* Design and build low-latency market making systems in modern C++
(C++17/20), optimising the hot path for memory, cache, and lock-free
performance.
* Own resilient connectivity to multiple crypto venues (Binance, Bybit,
Deribit, CoinDCX and more) over WebSocket and REST — handling reconnects,
heartbeats, sequence-gap recovery, and snapshot+delta order book reconstruction.
* Build a normalisation layer that tames inconsistent exchange APIs, rate
limits, and weight systems into one clean, reliable interface for strategies.
* Lead a team of quant developers — reviewing code, setting engineering
standards, breaking down work, and mentoring them into strong systems engineers.
* Deliver the quoting, order management, and risk-check components
end-to-end, partnering closely with traders and quants to translate strategy
needs into robust production systems.
* Measure and improve performance and reliability relentlessly —
instrumenting, benchmarking, and tuning the system against real latency budgets
dominated by network round-trips and exchange behaviour.You’ll Excel in This
Role If You


* Have 7–8 years building low-latency, high-throughput systems in C++, with
deep performance-engineering instincts (lock-free structures, no allocations on
the hot path, CPU pinning, profiling).
* Have shipped production systems with` persistent WebSocket and REST
connectivity at scale — trading background preferred, but strong low-latency
engineers from any domain are welcome.
* Think in first principles about where latency actually lives — network RTT,
exchange matching, and rate-limit budgeting — rather than mechanically applying
nanosecond-hardware playbooks.
* Have led as a tech lead — owning components, reviewing code, and guiding
junior engineers 
* Are obsessed with correctness and resilience under messy, inconsistent,
sometimes-failing exchange APIs.
* Communicate latency and risk tradeoffs clearly to traders and
non-engineers, and bring a measurement-driven, owner mindset.
* (Bonus) Understand crypto market microstructure — order books, funding
rates, perpetuals, liquidations, maker/taker fee tiers — or have worked with
kernel bypass, or colocation/proximity hosting.You’ll Know You’re Winning When

(Key success metrics for the first 6 months)


* You’ve taken ownership of the core market making stack and shipped
measurable latency and reliability improvements on the hot path.
* Your exchange connectivity layer maintains accurate order books with robust
gap recovery and minimal downtime across venues.
* Junior developers in the team are independently shipping reviewed,
high-quality components against a clear engineering standard you’ve set.
* Traders and quants trust your systems — quoting and risk checks run
consistently in production with fewer incidents and faster iteration.Why This
Role Matters & What’s In It For You

Market making is the heartbeat of an exchange — the systems you build
directly determine the liquidity, spreads, and trading experience for millions
of users. You’ll sit at the intersection of engineering, trading, and risk,
with real ownership over a business-critical edge.

You’ll work closely with senior leadership and our researchers and traders,
influence high-stakes technical and strategic decisions, and grow into a leader
of one of the most demanding engineering functions in one of the world’s
fastest-evolving industries.

How to Apply

This role is for you if you thrive on hard systems problems, love working
close to the action with sharp traders and engineers, and want to own
infrastructure that matters.

title: Assistant Manager/Manager - Qualitative Research

Associate Manager / Manager – Qualitative Research (Individual Contributor)


The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of Consumer-Centric Finance

Marketing, Strategy, Analytics, and the Founder's Office. We help the

Researcher to join our central Consumer Insights team.

* User experience and journey optimisation

* Customer acquisition and retention strategy

every important decision

complexity, there is a growing need for researchers who can uncover
motivations, anxieties, unmet needs, and behavioural patterns that cannot be
observed through data alone.
* There is a critical need for someone who can:
* Discover unmet customer needs before they become obvious to the market.
* Help Product and Design teams build experiences customers genuinely value.
* Build empathy across the organisation by bringing authentic customer voices
into business conversations.
* Translate qualitative observations into strategic recommendations that
influence decisions.
* Establish research as a strategic capability rather than a validation
function.

advantage for CoinDCX as we build the future of investing and digital finance.

What You'll Do


Customer Discovery & Qualitative Research


* Lead end-to-end qualitative research projects from business problem
definition to strategic recommendations.
* Design and execute research across customer, product, and brand domains.

* In-depth Interviews (IDIs)
* Focus Group Discussions (FGDs)
* Customer Immersions
* Ethnographic Research
* Diary Studies
* Contextual Inquiry
* Exploratory Research
* Usability Studies
* UX Research

behavioural patterns that influence business decisions.

evaluation.

business decisions.

opportunity maps.

Business teams.

approach.

Collaborate with Quantitative Research and Analytics teams on mixed-method
studies where required.

Champion customer empathy across the organisation.


Research Operations & Capability Building

knowledge repositories.

Leverage AI tools to improve research efficiency across interview synthesis,
thematic analysis, reporting, and insight generation.

Support the development of repeatable research frameworks and best practices.


You'll Excel in This Role If You Have


Core Requirements

3–5 years of experience in qualitative research.

Experience working with leading research agencies such as Kantar, Ipsos,
NielsenIQ, Human8, Quantum, FSG, or similar research and consulting firms.

Agency-only experience is absolutely acceptable.

Experience independently leading qualitative research studies.

Strong moderation skills across IDIs, FGDs, customer immersions, and
exploratory research.

Exceptional qualitative analysis and synthesis capabilities.

Excellent storytelling and presentation skills.

Ability to identify patterns across customer narratives and translate them

Experience managing multiple stakeholders and projects simultaneously.

Ability to thrive in ambiguity and solve complex business problems.


Preferred

technology categories.

Exposure to UX research and product discovery methodologies.

Familiarity with quantitative research fundamentals and mixed-method research.

Experience using AI tools to accelerate research planning, analysis,
synthesis, reporting, and insight generation.


What You'll Bring

Deep Customer Empathy

Exceptional Moderation & Interviewing Skills

Behavioural Analysis & Pattern Recognition

Strategic Storytelling & Insight Synthesis

Cross-Functional Stakeholder Collaboration

Product Discovery & Innovation Mindset

AI-Enabled Research Workflows

Ownership & Business Curiosity


You'll Know You're Winning When

Product, Design, and Marketing teams proactively seek research before making
key decisions.

Customer interviews consistently uncover actionable opportunities for product
and business improvement.

Research findings influence product roadmaps, customer experience
improvements, and growth initiatives.

Stakeholders reference customer insights during planning and decision-making
discussions.

Research outputs become faster, richer, and more scalable through effective
use of AI.

Customer empathy becomes embedded across teams rather than existing only
within the research function.


What Success Looks Like

A mature qualitative research practice that is trusted across the
organisation.

Customer insights directly influence product strategy, design decisions, and
brand initiatives.

Product teams develop experiences grounded in genuine customer needs rather
than assumptions.

Research becomes a strategic input into business planning rather than a
post-decision validation exercise.

The voice of the customer becomes embedded across Product, Design, Marketing,
Strategy, and Leadership decision-making.

Application Review

Recruiter Connect

functions.

title: Sr. Mrg/Assoc Dir - Category (F&O - Acquisition)
description:
The CoinDCX Journey

At CoinDCX, our mission is clear – to make crypto and blockchain accessible
to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance.

As India’s first crypto unicorn valued at $2.45B, we are reshaping the

with bold ideas, relentless execution, and people who want to build what’s next.

If you’re driven by purpose and thrive in environments where your work
defines the next chapter of an industry, you’ll feel right at home here.


About the Role

The Futures New Volume Charter is the growth engine for CoinDCX’s F&O
business. This charter owns the entire top-of-funnel and early lifecycle
journey – from acquiring new F&O users through Brand and Performance Marketing,
to activating them in M0 (first month) and building trading habit in M1 (second
month).

As Senior Manager, you will be the single owner of new user volume for
Futures. Your job is to ensure that the right users enter the funnel, activate
quickly, and ramp their trading volumes within the first two months. You’ll
work across Marketing, Product, Growth, and Data to build scalable
acquisition-to-activation systems – not one-off campaigns.

This is a high-stakes, high-autonomy charter. You’ll think like a GM for the
“new user” segment – owning the numbers, diagnosing problems from first
principles, and driving cross-functional execution with urgency. If the
situation demands, you will also build and manage a small team to scale this
charter.


What You’ll Do


* Own the New Volume Number: Be the DRI for new user MTUs and AVPUs across M0
and M1. Build a deep, decomposed view of what drives new user volume and own
each lever with full accountability.
* Drive Acquisition Strategy (Brand + Performance): Partner with Marketing
Team to shape the acquisition funnel for F&O. Influence Brand and Performance
Marketing spend, targeting, and messaging to ensure the right trader profiles
enter the funnel. Own the business case for acquisition budgets and hold
Marketing accountable for funnel quality, not just top-line leads.
* M0 Activation: Design and execute the activation playbook for new F&O
users. Ensure users who sign up place their first trade quickly and with
meaningful volume. Diagnose activation drop-offs, run experiments, and build
repeatable onboarding-to-first-trade systems.
* M1 Volume Ramp: Own the transition from “trial” to “habit.” Build programs
that increase trading frequency and volume in the user’s second month. Work
with Product and Growth to create nudges, incentives, and feature experiences
that deepen engagement before users reach the retention stage.
* Revenue Decomposition & Diagnosis: Break down new user revenue into its
constituent drivers (acquisition volume, activation rate, trades per user,
volume per trade). Identify which levers to pull, diagnose underperformance,
and design interventions grounded in data.
* Cross-Functional Execution: Work daily with Product, Growth, Marketing, and
Data teams. Influence without authority – align stakeholders around the new
volume charter, unblock execution bottlenecks, and ensure launches happen on
time and on target.
* Experimentation & Iteration: Build a culture of rapid experimentation. Run
A/B tests across onboarding flows, incentive structures, and engagement hooks.
Use data to iterate fast and scale what works.
* Strategic Communication: Present charter performance, insights, and
recommendations to the Category Head and leadership. Translate funnel metrics
into clear business narratives that drive resource allocation decisions.


You’ll Excel in This Role If You


* Think in Funnels and Cohorts: You naturally decompose a growth problem into
funnel stages and cohort behaviours. You know the difference between an
acquisition problem and an activation problem and solve accordingly.
* Have Acquisition DNA: You’ve worked closely with or within marketing/growth
teams. You understand CAC, payback periods, channel mix, and how to hold
acquisition spend accountable to downstream volume, not just sign-ups.
* Solve from First Principles: You don’t copy playbooks. You diagnose the
root cause, build a hypothesis, test it, and iterate. You ask “why” five times
before asking “how.”
* Are Data-Obsessed: You live in dashboards but don’t wait for them. You
write your own SQL, pull raw data, and form hypotheses before the weekly review.
* Influence Across Functions: You get things done through Product, Marketing,
and Tech without positional authority. You build trust through clarity and
follow-through.
* Move Fast with Rigour: You bias for action but never skip the “why.” You
can run a sprint and a strategy session in the same week.


Must-Have Qualifications


* 5–8 years of experience in business, category management, growth, or
revenue roles at high-growth companies.
* Prior experience owning acquisition, activation, or early-lifecycle metrics
for a product or category.
* Strong understanding of revenue decomposition, funnel analysis, and
cohort-based thinking.
* Demonstrated ability to work with and influence Marketing, Product, and
Growth teams.
* First-principles, business-first problem-solving orientation.
* Proficiency in SQL – ability to write queries, build analyses, and extract
insights independently.
* Excellent communication – can translate data into business narratives for
leadership.Nice-to-Have Qualifiers


* MBA from a Tier-1 institute.
* Prior category or P&L ownership experience.
* Experience at Tier-1 startups or high-growth B2C platforms.
* Familiarity with crypto, trading, or financial products.
* Experience managing performance marketing budgets or working closely with
performance teams.


Metric Ownership

* New User MTUs (M0 + M1) Unique new users actively trading Futures in their
first and second month. The primary measure of acquisition effectiveness and
early activation.


* New User AVPUs (M0 + M1) Average trading volume per new user in M0 and M1.
Measures depth of early engagement and quality of acquired users.


* Acquisition Funnel Quality Conversion from sign-up to first F&O trade
(activation rate), segmented by acquisition channel (Brand vs Performance).
Ensures marketing spend translates to real trading users.


* M0 → M1 Carry-Over Rate Percentage of M0 users who return and trade in M1.
The bridge metric between acquisition and retention.


Hiring Process


* Application Review – We assess for skills, alignment, and intent.
* Recruiter Connect – A short conversation to understand you better.
* Functional Round(s) – Deep dive into your approach, craft, and
problem-solving.
* Assignment / Simulation Round – A take-home task or live problem-solving
exercise to understand how you think and execute.
* Culture & Values Discussion – A conversation to understand our ways of
working and how you thrive best.
* Founder Conversation (Optional) – For certain roles, you may meet our
founders to explore strategic alignment.


Where We Work

We believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration,

real time.

title: Senior Associate – Market Risk
description:
The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of Finance:

At CoinDCX, our mission is clear - to make crypto and blockchain accessible
to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance.

About the Role:

This isn’t a typical Market Risk role.

This role is suited for a hands-on risk professional who can independently
execute BAU monitoring, build practical dashboards and controls, analyse market
events, and escalate issues with clarity across spot, derivatives, and
custody-linked exposures. You will work closely with the Manager and
cross-functional teams to strengthen risk measurement, liquidation and margin
monitoring, liquidity and slippage views, governance processes, and day-to-day
risk actions.


What You’ll Do:

1) Risk Measurement & Monitoring (BAU)

• Build, maintain, and run core risk views such as VaR (1-day/10-day), stress
tests, scenario loss, and drawdown / regime indicators for key exposures
including spot, perps / futures, and funding or basis-linked positions.

• Monitor volatility, correlations, concentration, and tail-risk indicators
on a daily basis; identify changes in risk posture and escalate material
observations in a timely manner.

• Prepare daily and periodic risk summaries with clear commentary,
exceptions, and recommended follow-ups.

2) Limits, Appetite & Governance Support

• Support the implementation and ongoing monitoring of risk limits across
notional, leverage, concentration, liquidity / slippage, and basis or funding
exposures.

• Track breaches, exceptions, and threshold movements; maintain escalation
logs, decision records, and supporting governance documentation.

• Assist in drafting and maintaining runbooks, SOPs, and risk dashboards so
that BAU processes remain consistent, auditable, and scalable.

3) Derivatives & Liquidation Risk Controls

• Monitor margin and liquidation risk across derivatives books, including
mark vs LTP behaviour, index / mark quality, liquidation outcomes, and tail-day
stress performance.

• Build and track metrics such as distance-to-liquidation (DTL), effective
leverage, margin utilisation, and early-warning indicators at user, token, or
portfolio level where relevant.

• Partner with Product, Operations, and Engineering teams to improve
practical guardrails such as risk checks, throttles, alerting logic, and
reduce-only or similar protective actions.

4) Liquidity & Slippage Risk

• Build and maintain liquidity risk views covering order book depth, spreads,
market impact, slippage, and exit capacity under normal and stressed conditions.

• Support stress liquidation cost analysis and time-to-exit estimation across
key tokens, books, and liquidity regimes.

• Highlight thin-liquidity, concentration, and execution-risk hotspots that
may require tighter controls or closer monitoring.

5) Risk Support & Cross-Functional Analysis

• Support analysis of venue constraints, hedgeability, pricing frictions, and
operational limitations that can affect market risk outcomes.

• Contribute to exposure monitoring across related areas such as stablecoin /
INR conversion impacts, treasury-linked positions, or exchange-specific market
structure issues where relevant.

• Work with stakeholders across Risk, Treasury, Product, Trade Ops, and
Analytics to improve data quality, monitoring coverage, and response readiness.

6) Controls, Incidents & Post-Mortems

• Participate in incident reviews for market events, liquidation anomalies,
pricing deviations, or control breakdowns; produce clear root-cause and impact
analysis.

• Maintain thresholds, control inventories, SOPs, and tracker-based
follow-ups so that risk actions are implemented and closed out properly.

• Recommend practical process improvements that help move quick tactical
monitoring into stronger BAU governance over time.


You’ll Excel in This Role If You:

• 3–6 years of experience in market risk, trading risk, treasury risk,
derivatives risk, or similar roles in a crypto exchange, broker, prop
environment, market maker, or related trading business.

• Good understanding of derivatives mechanics, including margining,
liquidation flows, funding rates, basis behaviour, and risk transmission during
stressed markets.

• Strong market microstructure intuition, including order book behaviour,
spreads, impact, mark vs LTP dynamics, manipulation or wick risk, and
thin-liquidity conditions.

• Hands-on comfort with risk analytics such as historical VaR, stress /
scenario testing, drawdowns, and regime-based monitoring.

• Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills; working knowledge of SQL preferred;
familiarity with dashboarding, data handling, or light automation is desirable.

• Ability to communicate risk observations clearly, maintain structured
documentation, and work effectively in a fast-moving operating environment.


You’ll Know You’re Winning When:


* Your risk frameworks directly guide trading and product decisions, keeping
the platform within strong risk boundaries.
* You establish a trusted, real-time “source of truth” for risk across spot
and derivatives.
* You anticipate market risks early and convert them into clear actions,
thresholds, and playbooks.
* You elevate overall risk maturity, enabling teams to better understand and
manage market volatility.

You gain the unique opportunity to establish the definitive "single source of
truth" at scale, moving beyond mere reporting to drive high-stakes innovation
in the Web3 space. This is a platform to exercise true ownership, where you
will solve industry-defining challenges and elevate the organization's
analytical maturity through visionary leadership and continuous analytical
evolution.

wallets, and market infrastructure. You’ll design and scale resilient,
low-latency database systems capable of handling extreme volatility and

will drive performance, data integrity, and system stability at “crypto-speed.”
This role demands deep technical ownership, where your decisions directly
impact uptime, risk, and user trust at scale.


What You’ll Do:


* Architectural Leadership: Lead the evolution of our global database
architecture using Aurora Global Databases to ensure low-latency access and

execution plans, and indexing strategies. Solve complex concurrency and locking

* Scaling & Capacity Planning: Manage database scaling strategies (Read
Replicas, Aurora Serverless v2, and Multi-AZ deployments) to handle massive
spikes in traffic during market volatility.
* Database Reliability (DBRE): Implement "Infrastructure as Code"
(Terraform/CDK) for database provisioning. Automate lifecycle management,
including patching, backups, and point-in-time recovery (PITR).
* Security & Compliance: Enforce strict encryption-at-rest and in-transit.
Implement fine-grained access control (IAM Database Authentication) and audit
logging to meet FinTech regulatory standards.

Product, and Engineering teams to ensure our custody infrastructure is
reliable, auditable, and continuously improving.

reconciliation discipline

wallets

documentationCross-Functional Collaboration

initiatives

functions

management

problem-solving

exercise to understand how you think and execute in real scenarios
* Culture & Values Discussion – A conversation to understand our ways of
working and how you thrive best
* Founder Conversation – For certain roles at senior levels, you may meet our
founders to explore strategic alignment and long-term fit

Where We Work


We believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration,
speed and trust come alive when teams share the same space.

With this belief, we operate as a work-from-office organisation. This role is
based out of ourBangalore office, where energy, alignment and innovation move
in real time.

Perks That Empower You


We believe great people deserve great experiences.


* Design Your Own Benefits: Flexible perks to match your lifestyle
* Unlimited Wellness Leaves: Rest and recharge as you need
* Mental Wellness Support: Access to therapy and wellness resources
* Learning Sessions: Bi-weekly learning and growth opportunities

Ready to Build What’s Next?


If you’re looking for a role that gives you direct access to high-stakes
decisions, deep impact and a chance to build the future of finance, this is it.

Join CoinDCX and help us make crypto accessible to every Indian, together.

You need to be a HODLer of these

comprehensive detailed specifications.

* Ability to write well-tested, thoughtful, and concise code and improve code
quality standards within the organization.

leaders.

title: Head of Legal (Interim)
description:
About the Role

We're looking for an interim Head of Legal to step into a General Counsel–level role with broad scope across corporate legal, strategic advisory, and treasury/TradFi matters. This is a senior, high-impact engagement - you'll oversee the legal team, act as a strategic partner to leadership on key initiatives, advise on upcoming product launches, and bring hands-on experience with traditional finance legal work.

What You'll Do

  • Provide strategic legal direction on major company initiatives while overseeing and managing the legal team to ensure continuity and consistency of legal operations

  • Advise on legal and structural considerations as we build, launch, and potentially spin out new products (regulatory considerations, entity and incentives structuring, employee contractual arrangements).

  • Act as a trusted legal advisor to senior leadership, with regular 1:1 engagement with key executives including the Executive Director

  • Apply your strong traditional finance legal expertise to lead legal work related to treasury operations, including trading documentation, derivatives agreements, and negotiations.

  • Provide day-to-day legal counsel across corporate, commercial (including IP), employment and operational matters.

  • Support cross-functional teams (Product, Growth, Operations) in integrating legal and compliance considerations into planning and execution

  • Ensure legal policies, controls, and governance practices stay fit for purpose, adjusting them as needed

  • Represent Legal at Board meetings as required

Who You Are

  • An established Legal expert and Leader with significant experience operating at General Counsel or senior legal leadership level

  • Strong combination of Web3/crypto and traditional finance (TradFi) legal experience

  • Expertise across a wide and diverse array of legal disciplines, including regulatory, employment, product, financial, and commercial/IP

  • Track record of managing or overseeing a legal team, ideally through periods of change or high growth

  • Experience advising on corporate structuring matters, including entity formation, spin-outs, or similar arrangements

  • Comfortable representing legal at Board level and communicating with senior executives and stakeholders

  • Able to operate independently in a remote, globally distributed organization, with enough working-hours overlap to collaborate closely with an European-based team

  • Available to start on short notice and flexible to support a structured handover at the start and end of the engagement

The Logistics

  • Full time, short-term engagement (6–8 months)

  • Flexible on engagement type (contract, fixed-term)

  • Competitive pay

  • Remote-first, with some overlap with European working hours required
